subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts the Department of the Interior, geothermal energy developers, and public land management in states with pending geothermal parcels.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Department of the Interior to increase the frequency of lease sales for developing and utilizing geothermal energy on federal land

dimensions.assessment: Accelerates federal land leasing schedules and imposes strict permit review deadlines on the Department of the Interior.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary shall... issue the permit... or defer the decision on the permit and provide to the applicant a notice

dimensions.assessment: Alters administrative and leasing workflows for federal lands, though specific federal revenue or spending changes are not quantified in the source.
Amends the Geothermal Steam Act of 1970 to alter leasing frequency, add replacement sale mandates, and establish statutory processing deadlines for drilling permits.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Geothermal Steam Act of 1970 to increase the frequency of lease sales, to require replacement sales, and for other purposes

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory changes to federal geothermal leasing mandates and agency permit consideration timelines.
dimensions.evidence: lease sales at least once a year (rather than two years) in states with pending nominations

missing_information: Specific estimates of the volume of additional geothermal energy produced or resulting lease sale revenues.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill increases the required frequency of federal geothermal lease sales from every two years to annually, mandates replacement sales if sales are canceled or delayed, and sets strict timelines for considering geothermal drilling permits.
